audit_method: Independent CPU reconstruction from pinned source, raw HTTP outputs, official shim prompt/tokenizer and persisted SQLite vectors; no new inference.
checks: Exact returned source bytes, window and excerpt hashes, adjusted inclusive line bounds
Full executable evidence interval required in actual delivered excerpt
Every condition/split hit@1, hit@3, hit@5, MRR, counts, medians, nearest-rank p95 and maxima
All 140 measured raw scoring responses: ordinal probabilities, expected score, confidence, official input-token counts
Each scored prefix equals first K unique retrieval-only windows; returned order and scores reconstruct correctly
All source character budgets and truncation flags truthful
Condition rotation, separate warmup, fresh inference call count, unchanged cached source manifest
Persisted SQLite active source windows, model metadata and finite document vectors
p95_note: Overall p95 uses the 19th of 20 measured searches; per-split p95 equals the maximum of 10. Latency includes absent cases; quality excludes them.
evaluation_scope: Fixed configurations and dataset split were declared before this repository inference. Both splits share one source-reviewed, authored repository dataset; no representative or repository-independent generalization claim.
